tool_args.rationale: The archive identifies a shared saturating sink-gradient base with an unresolved branch term. The lower-cost open-branch probe directly tests that ambiguity before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot signatures support its base and sink-gradient terms, but five rows may not distinguish the positive or negative square-root branch from linear leakage reliably.
The observed signatures point to a static siphon mechanism rather than a slow-horizon reversal.
There is no evidence favoring the coupled memory ODE over the siphon mechanism.
It is irrelevant to resolving the branch ambiguity.
